info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cosmetics Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Cosmetics Recliner Catalog Management API enables businesses to manage detailed information about cosmetics recliners in their product catalog. This API allows for the creation and submission of new recliner entries, ensuring that all relevant specifications and attributes are accurately documented. Typically used by e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, it facilitates the efficient handling of product listings and enhances the consumer's shopping experience. By streamlining catalog updates, businesses can adapt quickly to market demands and improve overall operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for a cosmetics recliner. It can be used to input specific information related to the features and specifications that enhance the product offering.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide details about a cosmetics recliner. It should include all necessary fields to accurately represent the recliner's specifications, features, and other relevant attributes.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the response contains the requested details.

CreateCatalogCosmeticsReclinerDetailRequ.title: Cosmetics Recliner Request Body

cosmetics_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the cosmetics recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of cosmetics recliners being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the cosmetics recliner.
